notes.title: Recent Updates and Upcoming Plans
notes.notes: [p]Dear Players,[/p][p] [/p][p]Greetings from Rolling Cat Studio, a small team of two humans and three cats![/p][p] [/p][p]It's been just over a week since Ink Reverie launched, and we're deeply grateful for your support. Seeing so many players thoughtfully designing and building their homesteads has been both heartwarming and exciting![/p][p] [/p][p]We've also received tremendous feedback on game balance, mechanics, and overall experience. Every suggestion has been carefully recorded and reviewed. Right now, we're focused on optimizing the game to make your adventure smoother and more enjoyable![/p][p] [/p][h2][b]What We've Been Working On[/b][/h2][p] [/p][p]In the past week, we've delivered near-daily updates addressing critical bugs while also implementing your most requested improvements, including:[/p][list][*][p]Better game balance: Optimized workforce requirements for productive units, adjusted rewards for high-level buildings, and improved resource management for a smoother experience![/p][/*][*][p]New quality-of-life features: Added a Photo Mode (hide UI for free screenshots), Sceneries Tracking, and clearer data statistics to make gameplay more convenient.[/p][/*][*][p]A pile of bug fixes: Save file issues, quest blockers, map display errors, and more…[/p][/*][/list][p]For a full list of updates, please check out the detailed patch notes later in the post![/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Future Plans[/b][/h2][p] [/p][p]We're carefully evaluating all your feedback - from control responsiveness to late-game depth and other crucial aspects. Our immediate focus will be tackling the most frequently reported issues. We're also fast-tracking development on highly requested features, including:[/p][list][*][p]Batch selection and movement of buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved controller support, likely using a virtual cursor + full-screen snapping design.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded judgment range for Sceneries..[/p][/*][/list][p]The game will keep getting regular updates in the coming days. If you had any concerns about certain designs or mechanics before, check out our full patch notes - if anything catches your eye, we'd love you to give the game another shot![/p][p] [/p][p]If you have any suggestions for improvements or thoughts about our current update direction, feel free to reach out anytime! We believe that through ongoing communication and refinement, Ink Reverie will become even more enjoyable![/p][p] [/p][p]Official Discord: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/kca52mNqeS"]https://discord.gg/kca52mNqeS[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Also, if you like our game, we’d greatly appreciate a positive review![/p][p] ____________________________________[/p][p][/p][p]The full patch notes are as follows:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Clay Mines in Vol. II: Camel Bells did not consume workforce.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an occasional issue where Clay Mines in Vol. II: Camel Bells could not be placed.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted water surface effects in Vol. II: Camel Bells.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where merchants could sometimes purchase items for free.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where productive units continued consuming resources after being paused.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the initial quest for workshops could not be completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Caverns might not be buildable in Vol. IV: Seasons' Bounty.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where victory fireworks would not stop.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the description of Alehouses—they now automatically collect all stone and mineral resources.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed screen tearing when moving the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the return button might disappear in the harbor map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect build requirements for the Lotus Pond Pavilion decoration in Vol. V: Chang'an Dream.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an incorrect merchant caravan limit in Vol. V: Chang'an Dream.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where porters would not notes.title: Ink Reverie is Now Available on Steam
notes.notes: [p]Hello there,[/p][p] [/p][p]This is Rolling Cat Studio, a small team of two humans and three cats.[/p][p] [/p][p]After more than two years of development, our game Ink Reverie is finally ready to meet you all. The game is priced at 9.99 USD, but during the launch sale, you can grab it for just 8.99 USD. We've also released the official OST alongside the game, so feel free to check it out if you're interested.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Yw-oSL1EKzM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Ink Reverie is a relaxing construction game set in the world of ancient Chinese architecture. You can merge and upgrade buildings, gather resources while idling, and design your city however you like. On certain maps, you'll also experience a trading gameplay mechanic. We studied numerous classical paintings, visited real-world locations, and blended historical and fictional elements to bring our vision to life. From the water towns of Jiangnan and the camel bells of the Western Regions, to the ancient port of Quanzhou, the historic architecture of Shanxi, and the grandeur of Chang'an during the Tang Dynasty, all of these influences are packed into the game.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3084260"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] To be honest, the development process was more challenging than we expected. We originally planned to include seven maps, but due to the overwhelming workload, we had to scale it back to five. However, we poured even more effort into the remaining maps. Each building tier in the game has a unique appearance, and aside from upgradable structures, we've also created a wealth of decorative elements. The launch version features over 500 hand-drawn ancient buildings and ornaments. Compared to the demo's first map, every map in the full game is at least twice as large, each with its own unique mechanics and gameplay.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107118/5b8fa63d0d76ca3e35e8457a0a9fd2ab74ae2ab9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Ink Reverie is a project we've poured our hearts into, and we're truly proud of it. Of course, even now, the game may not be perfect—there are areas that still need improvement. After the launch, we'll be listening to your feedback and continue optimizing the game. If sales allow, we're eager to develop new content and even release standalone DLCs in the future.[/p][p] [/p][p]If this game brings you a few enjoyable evenings, or even just a fleeting thought of “Ancient Chinese architecture is truly beautiful,” then all our hard work over these two years will have been worth it.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you for reading this far, and we hope you'll enjoy this little passion project of ours![/p][p] [/p][p]Wishing you all a wonderful time playing![/p][p] [/p][p]— Rolling Cat Studio[/p][p]July 2025[/p][p] [/p][p]P.S. Before launch, our final task was adding controller support to the game. Unfortunately, we're not fully satisfied with the experience — it works now, but there are still many rough edges and bugs that need polishing. We'll continue optimizing it in the coming weeks.[/p][p] [/p][p]If you have any thoughts, suggestions, or encounter issues, please don't hesitate to reach out![/p][p][/p][p]Our discrod server: [url="https://discord.gg/kca52mNqeS"]https://discord.gg/kca52mNqeS[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again![/p]

notes.title: Ink Reverie comes to Steam Next Fest！
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]
[b]Ink Reverie[/b] is taking part in this June's Steam Next Fest—you're warmly invited to try out the demo![/p][p]
In this demo version, the game fully showcases the first level, where players can freely build a charming southern-style village and work to increase its prosperity. You'll get to experience the core appeal of [b]Sui Ink Reverie[/b]: synthesis, building, and relaxing gameplay![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107118/48a8495c1bee029f8bb908ed6a8b3d848dc70dd5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Since the release of our previous demo, we've made various adjustments based on player feedback, including tweaks to values and the UI. [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/nTuYFfvAsD"]https://discord.gg/nTuYFfvAsD[/url][/p][p][/p][p]The full version of the game is planned to launch in July. The exact date will be announced soon—stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Ink Reverie’s first public demo will be at Wholesome Games Steam Celebration!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Greetings from Rolling Cat Studio!

We're excited to introduce Ink Reverie, our ongoing project inspired by the Tang and Song dynasties. This ancient city-building game is set in a fictional historical era and features a stunning traditional Chinese art style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107118/7524724b9153d36f1433c81632075f28928a5979.jpg[/img]

Check out our first trailer here:
[previewyoutube=ynP6uJcs-2A;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re also thrilled to announce that Ink Reverie has been selected for the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration (August 15-21)! During the event, we’ll be releasing our very first public demo.

[h3]What’s in the Demo?[/h3]

The demo offers a glimpse into the game’s first chapter, Jiangnan Mountain Village, allowing players to explore the core concepts and mechanics of Ink Reverie:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107118/98780d80ae919fd63289f3bfbb45e954244dfb41.gif[/img]

In this demo version, the maximum level for all buildings is level 4.

[list]
[*] [b]Tutorial[/b]: Get to know the basics through an introductory tutorial.
[*] [b]Immersive Experience[/b]: Travel back a thousand years and immerse yourself in the rich cultural environment and natural beauty of ancient China's Jiangnan region.
[*] [b]Early Gameplay[/b]: Guide a dilapidated village from ruins to prosperity in the early stages of the game.
[/list]

Don't forget to wishlist our game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3084260/

Thank you for your attention and support! We hope you enjoy our demo. If you're interested in the game, we invite you to join our player community: [url=https://discord.gg/kca52mNqeS]https://discord.gg/kca52mNqeS[/url]
